# Allowed permissions for EVTasker.
# Any uses-permission in a manifest NOT listed here FAILS the CI.
# Why: this app decides when settings get written to a car, and now writes them directly
# (system app). Every new permission widens what a rule can reach and must be reviewed here.
#
# One line = one full permission name. '#' = comment.

# --- Vehicle access (system app) ---
# EVTasker reads and writes the vehicle directly through EVHardware. These car
# permissions are signature|privileged and are granted because the app is signed with the
# ROM platform key and declares sharedUserId="android.uid.system" (same as EVProfile).
android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY
android.car.permission.CAR_POWERTRAIN
android.car.permission.CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION
android.car.permission.CONTROL_CAR_CLIMATE
android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS

# --- Own vehicle service ---
# A persistent foreground service inits EVHardware and listens for ignition; it starts at
# boot to catch the first ignition without the app being opened.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE
# The same service holds a position subscription while it lives, and since API 34 a
# foreground service only reaches a "while in use" permission through a matching type.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS

# --- Bluetooth ---
# Paired list for the editor + live connection tracking (ACL) for context conditions.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
# Reads which phone the head unit made hands-free, for the "hands-free phone"
# condition. Granted by the platform signature only.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED

# --- Contacts ---
# Read-only access, requested only while configuring "Call a contact". The OEM PBAP client
# publishes the paired phone's explicitly shared phone book through ContactsContract.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS

# --- Messages ---
# The "send a message" action. The car has no SIM: the message is handed to the paired
# phone over the Bluetooth message profile and the phone sends it, but the platform counts
# that as an SMS send and the Bluetooth stack enforces this permission on the call.
# Requested only while writing that action; nothing is read, and no message is ever sent
# without a rule the user wrote.
android.permission.SEND_SMS

# Signature permission defined by EVTasker to reject forged OEM hard-key broadcasts.
com.evsuite.tasker.permission.RECEIVE_HARDKEY

# --- Optional EVProfile bridge (profile action only) ---
# Signature-level, obtained solely because both APKs share the platform key. Used only to
# apply an EVProfile profile when EVProfile is installed.
com.evsuite.profile.permission.CONTROL_PROFILES

# --- Position ---
# The "near a place" condition, and nothing else. Last known fix only (no live request), read
# on the device, compared against a point stored in the rule; the coordinates never leave the
# car. Refusing it disables that single condition.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION

# --- Network ---
# Two uses, both explicit:
#   • Console → Share uploads the diagnostic report to a PrivateBin paste
#     (paste.chapril.org): encrypted client-side, password-protected, 1-hour expiry, and
#     only after the user confirms. Both flavors.
#   • The unstable channel self-updates (GitHub pre-releases, https + host allowlist +
#     same-signature check). Unstable only — stable contains no updater code.
# No background traffic in either flavor.
android.permission.INTERNET
